meta.title: After an honest pay into NEAR Intents, the outsider tries to withdraw or move sam's credit
meta.breaks: Checks that a credit inside NEAR Intents stays with the receiver: the outsider calls ft_withdraw and mt_transfer on Intents directly for sam's 100.
meta.expected_safe_result: both Intents calls fail (they move only the caller's own credit); sam keeps 100 credited inside Intents
meta.author: hand-written for the intents suite (Arena, 2026-11-11)
